$comment: AutoStacc engine contract v1: every code an engine may answer. archive: the job failed as a whole ({error}). file: an issue on one file ({code, refused}). service: the HTTP service only. A replacement engine uses exactly these codes.

archive.truncated: The archive ends early or its directory is damaged.
archive.central_directory_too_large: The archive's directory is over 64 MB.
archive.too_large: The files add up to more than the limit.

file.path_traversal: The name climbs out of the archive (..).
file.absolute_path: The name is an absolute path or a drive.
file.reserved_name: The name is reserved on Windows (CON, NUL, COM1, ...).
file.unsupported_compression: Compressed with a method other than store or deflate.
file.file_too_large: One file over the per-file limit.
file.suspicious_compression_ratio: Expands more than 200 times (a decompression bomb).
file.damaged_entry: The entry's header is missing or its data runs into the directory.
file.size_mismatch: It expands to a different size than declared.
file.crc_mismatch: Its bytes don't match their checksum.
file.content_does_not_match_name: The bytes are a different kind of file than the name says.
file.case_collision: Same path as another file except for letter case (warning).

service.bad_request: The job isn't valid JSON or misses fields.
service.bad_source: The source isn't an allowed bucket and key (or a local file in development).
service.unknown_op: Not one of list, inspect, file.
service.bucket_not_allowed: The bucket isn't on the engine's list.
service.busy: Another job is running; retry later.
